theme: An open day with a few trip threads to tie off.
greeting: Good morning, Dan. The calendar is wide open today — no meetings on it — so the day is yours to spend on what's been waiting.

needsAttention.title: Last Dubrovnik night still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: The single Sept 19 night in Cavtat, near the airport before your 7:30am flight out, is the one gap left in the Croatia lodging — open since Aug 23. The first three nights are already confirmed.

needsAttention.title: Confirm checked bags on the Croatia ticket
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows zero checked bags on Basic Economy, and both legs run on Eurowings Discover. Worth confirming the allowance on the operating carrier's own site and buying bags online now, before airport-counter fees.

needsAttention.title: St Pete landing-gap nights, Sept 20-21
needsAttention.detail: Two nights after you land TPA and before the Tue Sept 22 pickup still need a room. The pending Sept 27 St Pete Airbnb is also worth a glance to confirm it converted rather than expiring.

recipe.title: Salmon Baked in Foil
recipe.why: High summer wants the lightest possible touch on good fish, letting the season's herbs and heat do the work.

acts.line: The day opens empty on the calendar — nothing to climb toward.
A rare unbroken stretch, yours to point at whatever's been circling.
The girls are home with you and Mike — an evening that lands in the kitchen.
